id: title:Gilbert09:keep transient s3 blips out of error tracking at the activity boundary

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability and error handling
review.reason: The change introduces a new exception class `TransientObjectStoreError` and its parent hierarchy, replacing generic `OSError` with this specific exception when transient S3 failures occur during warehouse ingestion. review.uncertainty: While the code demonstrates a clear implementation of a transient error handling strategy, the actual benefit depends on the frequency and nature of transient S3 errors in production, which is not established by this diff. The tier is assigned based on the implementation of a bounded, substantive improvement to ingestion reliability, not on unverified production outcomes.
